settings.title: Settings
settings.showSummary: Show the summary in the list
settings.duplicatesHelp: Groups articles about the same story across several sources. Groups are recomputed on every change.
settings.autoMarkRead: Automatically mark old articles as read
settings.autoMarkReadHelp: Articles published longer ago than this arrive already read, at the next refresh.
settings.retentionHelp: Unread articles and favorites are always kept. Read articles stay findable in History and search until they are deleted.
settings.fontClassic: Serif title, text like the interface
settings.archiveHelp: A favorite’s images are kept separately: the cache size limit and “Clear cache” never touch them. The full text is only archived if the article has already been opened in Flux.

addFeed.title: Add a feed
addFeed.help: Paste the address of the RSS or Atom feed, or just the site's address: the feed will be detected automatically.

errors.notAFeed: No RSS or Atom feed found at this address.
errors.alreadyExists: This feed is already in your list.

dialogs.deleteFeedBody: The feed and its articles will be deleted. Favorites stay in Favorites.
dialogs.deleteFolderBody: The feeds in the folder are not deleted: they go back to the top level.
dialogs.deleteTagBody: The articles stay in favorites, without this tag.

filters.title: Filters
filters.empty: No rules yet. Add a keyword to hide articles whose title contains it.
filters.footer: Rules match the title, ignoring case and accents. They apply to existing articles and to new ones. Favorites are never filtered. Deleting a rule brings back the articles it hid.
filters.deleteBody: The articles it hid will come back.

opml.title: OPML
opml.none: No subscriptions found in this file.
opml.imported: Import finished: {{added}} added, {{skipped}} skipped (already present or invalid). Articles will arrive shortly.

sync.enable: Sync with my other Macs (iCloud Drive)
sync.help: Feeds, folders, tags, filters, read articles and favorites are shared through iCloud Drive, with no account or server. Works with the original Flux app.
sync.icloudUnavailable: iCloud Drive is not turned on on this Mac.
sync.permission: Flux doesn't have permission to access iCloud Drive. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security > Files & Folders (or Full Disk Access), allow Flux, then try again: sync retries on its own every 30 seconds.

backup.help: One archive per day, stored in iCloud Drive/Flux/Sauvegardes Tauri. Unlike sync, it's a frozen snapshot: a deletion never erases anything from it.
backup.includeArchiveHelp: Thumbnails of your favorites, so they come back after a restore without being downloaded again.
backup.restoreConfirm: Restore “{{name}}”? Flux will restart. Your current database is set aside, and the restored content will be sent to your other Macs if they sync.
backup.relaunchManually: Backup ready. Quit and reopen Flux to apply it.

swiftImport.title: Bring your data over?
swiftImport.message: A previous version of Flux was found on this Mac. Do you want to import your feeds, folders, articles, favorites, tags, rules and settings? Your old app is left untouched.
swiftImport.menu: Import data from the previous version
swiftImport.done: Imported: {{articles}} articles, {{feeds}} feeds, {{folders}} folders, {{tags}} tags, {{rules}} rules.

update.title: Update available
update.message: Flux {{version}} is available. Flux will download it, install it and restart.
update.installing: Downloading the update… Flux will restart by itself.

welcome.title: Welcome to Flux
welcome.text: An RSS reader for Mac with no algorithm and no directory: you pick your sources, Flux presents them neatly.

add.title: Add your sources
add.text: Paste the address of a site or of its feed: Flux finds the feed by itself.
add.tip1: The + button or ⌘N adds a feed
add.tip2: File your feeds in folders (right-click › Move to)
add.tip3: Coming from another reader? Menu › Import feeds (OPML)

read.title: Read without leaving the app
read.text: When a feed only gives an excerpt, Flux fetches the full article and shows it in a readable layout.
read.tip1: The same story published by several sources shows up only once
read.tip2: j / k: next or previous article; space: scroll

sort.title: Sort things out
sort.text: Filter rules hide articles, or mark them as read, when their title contains a keyword, on all your feeds or only some.
sort.tip1: Menu › Filters to create a rule
sort.tip2: The eye button in the toolbar hides read articles

keep.title: Keep what matters
keep.text: Favorites are archived in full, images included: you can read them again even if the site deletes them.
keep.tip1: Organize favorites with tags (tagging an article adds it to favorites)
keep.tip2: Print an article or export it as PDF (⌘P)

icloud.title: Sync and back up
icloud.text: With iCloud Drive, your feeds, favorites and read articles follow you to your other Macs, and a full copy of Flux is backed up every day.

stats.title: Reading statistics
stats.footer: An article counts as read after being open for 3 seconds. Tracked since {{date}}.
stats.footerNone: An article counts as read after being open for 3 seconds. No reading recorded yet.

about.title: About Flux
about.tagline: A simple RSS reader for macOS: your feeds, thumbnails, and the full article without opening the browser.
about.credits: Created by Aervorn, with help from Claude.
